newsitem.title: UK: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.96 bln Oct.
newsitem.headline: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.96 bln Oct.

text.p: The UK Building Societies Association (BSA) released the following, seasonally adjusted, data on lending -
MORTGAGE ADVANCES AND NEW APPROVALS TO LEND
NOTES - approval = borrower accepts offer of advance; advance = actual loan, on average some 10 wks after commitment; advances tend to reflect new approvals made 2 or 3 mths ago.

Adrian Coles, director-general of the BSA said: "While there is usually an upturn in savings at this time of year as people begin to save for Christmas, seasonally adjusted figures show that building societies' inflow was more than twice as much in October than in the previous month and was the highest since September last year."
Coles said gross advances were nine percent higher than in the previous month and net advances and approvals 19 percent and 11 percent higher respectively.

"While the recovery in mortgage lending is soundly based, the quarter percentage point rise in base rates at the end of October, along with the approaching budget, may have introduced some uncertainty into the market which could affect lending in the next month or so," Coles said.
